slick.options.title: Slick
slick.options.style.tooltip: The shape of everything. Modern: rounded panels with soft slot tiles. Cards: every section floats as its own card. Minimal: flat and quiet, with an underline for the selected slot. Outline: see-through panels drawn with thin lines. Bevel: square, crisp edges with depth, a modern take on the pixel look.
slick.options.theme.tooltip: The colors. Midnight: deep blue-grey. Graphite: neutral dark grey. Frost: see-through glass over a blurred world. Daylight: light panels with dark text. Onyx: pure black.
slick.options.accent.tooltip: The color of the selected hotbar slot, hovered slots and progress bars. Theme uses the theme's own accent.
slick.options.opacity.tooltip: How solid the panels are. Lower lets more of the world show through.
slick.options.corners.tooltip: How rounded panels and slots are.
slick.options.shadows.tooltip: A soft shadow around the hotbar and menus.
slick.options.speed.tooltip: How quickly the hotbar selection glides, hovered slots light up and menus open. Off makes everything snap.
slick.options.hotbar.tooltip: Replace the hotbar with Slick's. Off keeps the vanilla hotbar.
slick.options.hotbar_slots.tooltip: Draw a box behind each hotbar slot. Off gives a cleaner single bar.
slick.options.wrap.tooltip: Scrolling from the last slot to the first glides around the edge instead of sliding all the way back.
slick.options.lift.tooltip: The item in the selected slot rises a little.
slick.options.menus.tooltip: Restyle the inventory, creative inventory and every vanilla container: crafting table, chests, barrels, ender chests, shulker boxes, hoppers, dispensers, droppers, furnaces, smokers, blast furnaces, brewing stands, anvils, smithing tables, grindstones, stonecutters, looms, cartography tables, enchanting tables, beacons, crafters, villager trading and horse inventories.
slick.options.blur.tooltip: Blur the world behind open menus. Uses the strength of Minecraft's Menu Background Blur setting.
slick.options.keys.tooltip: Set a key that opens these settings in game.
slick.options.reset.tooltip: Put every setting back to its default.
